The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life sounds like the exact kind of generic "banished from the party" light novel adaptation you'd watch for ten minutes, roast online, and immediately drop. On the surface, it’s just another one of the 40+ wish-fulfillment fantasy shows that have aired in the last year.

Dig a little deeper, though, and you’ll find P.A. Works animation, a theatrical-quality 2D dragon fight in episode two, and a fantasy swordswoman unloading a literal Uzi on a talking gold dragon. In this review, I break down how this show uses the banished-from-the-party trope as a cheap costume for a wild Looney Tunes-style comedy—and how it somehow balances slapstick corporate satire with brutal tonal whiplash and a surprisingly real story about burnout.
